title: Distance on the Coordinate Plane
topic: Finding horizontal/vertical distance between points; area and perimeter on the coordinate plane

items.prompt: Point A is at (-4, 5) and Point B is at (2, 5). Since they share the same y-coordinate, what is the horizontal distance between them?
Point C is at (3, 7) and Point D is at (3, -2). What is the vertical distance between them?
To find the distance between two points that share the same y-coordinate, you should:

choices.B: Find the absolute value of the difference of the x-coordinates
choices.C: Find the absolute value of the difference of the y-coordinates

items.rationale: When y-values match, horizontal distance = |x2 - x1|.

items.prompt: A rectangle on the coordinate plane has corners at (0,0), (6,0), (6,4), and (0,4). What is its area?
Using the same rectangle with corners (0,0), (6,0), (6,4), (0,4), what is its perimeter?
